metadata.description: Claude Code mods by Parais Gergely.

plugins.name: zsemle
plugins.description: A pixel-art companion above the Claude Code prompt (15 figures, each with its own sound) that watches every usage limit, gets tired as the limit runs low, shows a mini figure per running subagent, guards file writes and offers optional helpers (weekly budget, commit guard, morning brief and more). English and Hungarian, terminal and desktop.
